tests.T1: Chat capability — what the agent can do inside chat answers
tests.T2: Service usage — services the agent can discover and call out to
tests.T4: Process management — pipeline, concurrency, quota recovery
tests.T5: Tool management — per-tool rules shared across agents
tests.T6: Session continuity — sessions, context, crash-safe resume

classValues.adapter: works via a per-class adapter (see notes)
classValues.false: explicitly out of scope for this class

capabilities.prove: unit test scripts/lib/tg-copy-code.test.mjs
capabilities.notes: Native <pre> copy blocks + copy_text buttons via sendCopyable (bot-host, collab-bot). Hermes gateway renders fenced blocks; buttons are bot-host/collab only.

capabilities.prove: live smoke: matrix PNG delivered; user-asked tables arrive aligned, never raw pipes; JSON pipeline builds on VPS
capabilities.notes: Matrix table standardised. Generic agent-emitted JSON→table pipeline still open: one shared convention, no second format per bot. Collab replies link-only. Delivery guarantee (auto-align to <pre>) lives in chunkForTelegram/sendCopyable: covers bot-host family + collab router. Grok TG router sends plain text (no parse_mode), so its path is the MEDIA: pipeline, not pre-blocks; Hermes gateway is a separate stack.

capabilities.prove: unit test + live long answers unsplit mid-word
capabilities.notes: chunkText long-message splitting. Hermes/router use their own senders with the same limits.

capabilities.prove: live smoke: bug dispatch lands in orchestrator queue
capabilities.notes: Bug → orchestrator so the agent doesn't fix it itself. status/stop/cancel/list-models per bug (V-29). Box lanes have their own dispatch.

capabilities.prove: live smoke: Meal-* audit bundle written
capabilities.notes: Model A self-serves via shared skill (contact model A); never message @Meal_audit_bot from coding bots.

capabilities.prove: live smoke: QA screenshot + ticket handoff
capabilities.notes: QA observes+reports, never diagnoses. telegram-testing is the shared pass/fail standard for all delivery claims.

capabilities.prove: live smoke: / popup lists commands on each class
capabilities.notes: Single BOT_COMMANDS source published via setMyCommands (bot-host + provider-router). Collab exposes /help text instead of a registered menu.

capabilities.prove: unit test scripts/lib/tg-progress.test.mjs + renderer headline test tests/bot-host.test.ts
capabilities.notes: One shared working headline (provider + model + thinking + elapsed + usage %, with 60/75% context warnings), ported from the Grok TG router's formatWorkingHeadline into scripts/lib/tg-progress.mjs; every bot-host agent sets it (vm/opencode/vm2/mobile). Collab sends single thinking notes, no live headline. Hermes gateway is a separate stack.

capabilities.prove: live smoke: dots never gap on a >30s run
capabilities.notes: V-28: sendChatAction pulse every 4s + trailing ... + waiting-for lines. Collab pulses during long jobs only.

capabilities.prove: unit behaviour: bursts serialised, no flood 429
capabilities.notes: Flood protection on bot-host send path. Hermes/router apply their own equivalents.

capabilities.prove: live smoke: MEDIA: PNG arrives as photo
capabilities.notes: Outbound MEDIA: convention (§14.7 Case B). Grok TG uploads if the host can, else links.

capabilities.prove: live smoke: photo → absolute path in prompt, per class
capabilities.notes: One downloader (§14.7 Case C). Grok TG import/mirror into the router still pending; Hermes profile wiring per-profile.

capabilities.prove: live smoke: depleted lane → same prompt completes on next lane with switch line
capabilities.notes: Grok-built buckets/deplete-tracking/failover vendored; bot-host has vocabulary + runWithModelFailover but live auto-failover wiring is still open. Collab quota is compute units, not Muse buckets.

capabilities.prove: unit test: provider stderr classified in ~10s, small=true ignored
capabilities.notes: extractLogError/humanizeRunError + --print-logs fail-fast. small=true title-agent errors never fatal. Router mirrors the vocabulary.

capabilities.prove: live smoke: second agent routes around claimed files, never refuses
capabilities.notes: Per-file advisory claims replace the old global dispatch lock. Chat never gated; same-file overlap warns, never blocks.

capabilities.prove: live smoke: status/stop/list-models on a live bug id
capabilities.notes: V-29 ops: per-bug records, action-aware heartbeats, 3m stagnation breaker. Single-runtime by design.

capabilities.prove: live smoke: killed service restarts; one poller per token enforced
capabilities.notes: systemd restart + registry one-poller guard (BOT-5). Phone uses its own restart loop; Colab uses the GPU-only watchdog.

capabilities.prove: live smoke: /models + /freemodel list; mid-chat /model switch works
capabilities.notes: Learnings land in the picker/catalog once; all agents inherit. Cline Free deepseek is wallet-independent of OpenCode.

capabilities.prove: unit behaviour: thinking variants + compressed reasoning traces
capabilities.notes: Thinking-level quirks (variants, CLINE_THINKING_LEVELS, compression) propagate here, not per-bot.

capabilities.prove: unit test failure-log roundtrip/grouping; review flags repeats at threshold
capabilities.notes: Learning loop: opencode failures auto-record (lane/kind/hint, best-effort, BOT_FAILURE_LOG=0 disables); review-failures.mjs groups by signature — 2nd occurrence without a linked sensor/learning must produce one (ratchet). Grok TG keeps its ticket reports; Hermes stack separate.

capabilities.prove: live smoke: /new /compact /abort behave per class; resume after restart
capabilities.notes: NEW (added by this review): per-chat sessions + crash-safe resume. CB-8 cross-turn memory still open; that's the remaining partial.
